trigger: An operator-created candidate PR is approved for the hosted verifier and repair cycle
problem: A deliberately seeded candidate may violate duration aggregation despite passing the original acceptance suite

evidence.observation: The six fixed acceptance tests do not cover totals above 180 minutes

user_impact: Long durations must return their full total rather than an arbitrary maximum
proposed_change: Independently inspect the candidate and repair any scoped violation of the full duration contract
alternatives: Stop for human intervention if the finding cannot be repaired within the approved file
acceptance_criteria: All nonnegative whole-hour and whole-minute tokens accumulate without an arbitrary upper bound
Ordering, repeated units, whitespace, single-unit and zero values preserve their specified behavior
Empty, negative, fractional, unsupported and malformed inputs remain rejected
The CLI and Python function produce the same total
Only src/duration.py changes; all six predefined tests remain unchanged
risks_non_goals: This is an explicitly seeded regression trial, not a naturally discovered Scout finding
A correct candidate must pass without inventing a blocker to force repair
No changes to tests, dependencies, workflows, permissions or configuration
The worker must not publish, merge or deploy
The workflow must leave the PR for human merge
dependencies: Python 3.12, the pinned Workbench engine and a dedicated OpenAI API key
